title: London Vegan Places
description: A community-built map of vegan and vegan-friendly places in London.
verification_policy: Only entries with status=verified are mapped. A verified record requires a current first-party source for the venue's address and evidence that it is currently operating. Vegan status is recorded separately.

verified_venues.name: E3 Vegan
verified_venues.verification_note: Official website confirms the Roman Road address and current Friday–Sunday café service plus Friday/Saturday evening dining.

verified_venues.name: Mildreds Camden
verified_venues.verification_note: Official branch page confirms address, opening hours and that the menu is fully plant-based. This verifies the Camden branch only.

verified_venues.name: Club Mexicana — Mayfair
verified_venues.address: St Mark’s Church, North Audley Street, London W1K 6ZA
verified_venues.verification_note: Official website lists this location and describes the food as zero meat / 100% plant-based.

verified_venues.name: Club Mexicana — Boxhall City
verified_venues.address: Boxhall City, Liverpool Street, London EC2M 7PN
verified_venues.verification_note: Official Club Mexicana website lists Boxhall City as a current location and describes the food as zero meat / 100% plant-based.

verified_venues.name: Mallow — Borough Market
verified_venues.verification_note: Official website confirms 100% plant-based food, address and current opening hours.

verified_venues.name: Unity Diner
verified_venues.verification_note: Official contact page confirms address and opening hours; official FAQ confirms the restaurant is 100% vegan.

verified_venues.name: Dauns
verified_venues.verification_note: Official website describes the business as fully vegan and confirms its Wentworth Street address and current opening hours.

verified_venues.name: Plates
verified_venues.verification_note: Official site confirms the Old Street address, current restaurant booking information and plant-based food ethos. The restaurant is described as plant-based; check directly for any menu or dietary changes.
